idea-plugin.name: Manifest Snippets + Removed-API Audit
idea-plugin.description:
For platform engineers on AKS: 28 rules naming every removed apiVersion, literal credential and :latest tag in the file you have open, and 40 snippets written against the versions that still exist.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Manifest Snippets + Removed-API Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cloud-manifest-audit-kit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cloud-manifest-audit-kit

action.text: Manifest Snippets + Removed-API Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Manifest Snippets + Removed-API Audit on the file in the editor
